notes.title: 0.5.9.1 added features
notes.content:
Thanks to all the playtesters helping make this a truly special game. Based on feedback, I've adjusted or added the following:
- goal shield collision while carrying ball fixed

- higher minimum throw speed

- instant enhanced max throw following an air skill for a brief amount of time, to reward use of air skills and incentive chaining together moves

- ball cam when wall jumping camera issue fixed

- slightly higher maximum wall jump speed

- slightly faster wall jump strength load

- visual indicator of attack sphere when attacking

notes.title: 0.5.7.1 update
notes.content:
Alpha 0.5.7.1 is live!


Are you in THE PITCH Discord yet? Opt in to early playtesting, receive updates, kick it with a cool and funny community, give suggestions, life advice, share cat pics, your opinion on Voodoo Chips, etc

Join THE PITCH Discord


Changes/Fixes
Various networking and host migration bugfixes

Menu tweaks; some previews of modes to come (!)

Tutorial (version 0.1) added to Training section. Please let me know if you break it and please share with me how!

Sometimes movement would feel frustrating or unexpected with collisions with head or feet on some objects, so the standard capsule height for the player is now shorter for less collision with head and feet

Grabbing players can now get stunned from attacks by grabbed players. 

Grabbing players will also get stunned if they are brought to a wall or buoy and knocked off the grabbed player - even if they're on the same team. No more hitching a ride forever!

Player in-game nametags are now hidden behind objects and the ball. The shape of the nametag is less rounded (for now) but functionally, it's no longer obstructing in-game objects.


Check out the new Alpha Announcement Trailer on Youtube!

In the works:
A main menu party/lobby system

More host migration tweaks and fixes

Crash logs

Post game replay/in-game instant replay

Spectator mode

More training modes

Much more!


See the full roadmap in THE PITCH Discord!

notes.title: Latest Update
notes.content:
0.5.5 is live

 major network updates for spawning after a goal/resetting a faceoff
 more air control. airborne acceleration 300 -> 450, over max speed deceleration 300 -> 350, braking deceleration airborne unchanged at 20.
 major punching/combat overhaul, added some different combat animations to the punch right to toy around with
 new player stunned vfx
 in game and front end music player bug fixes
 solved issues with hand thruster visual bugs
 various bug/edges cases with color assignments at game start
 fixed (lack of) collision bug with goal posts
 fixed control bug where player would occasionally not turn to where the camera is pointing when first aiming
 fixed audio bug where thruster sound occurred when entering directional input while aiming
 slightly bigger arena
 adjusted node, goal, goal screen, defense zone, and dust particle locations and sizes to fit bigger arena
 update faceoff locations
 fixed camera interpolation to be more responsive when aiming while air dashing
 general character orient while aiming improvements
 added new kits to the locker room


Be sure to join the Discord to get the latest updates sooner, and be involved in alpha testing. Help shape the direction of this game with an awesome community of cool people!
